user.title: Brick Hub
user.description: Lets Home Assistant trigger the Brick Hub iPhone app. The phone keeps the rules (strict mode, emergency unbricks, the reset) and works without Home Assistant. After this, link the phone from the app: Settings → Link Home Assistant.

abort.already_configured: Brick Hub is already set up.

push.title: Push to iPhone (APNs)
push.description: Recommended: lets Home Assistant reach the phone instantly, even when the app is closed. Without push, commands only reach the phone while the app is open. Use an APNs auth key (.p8) from your Apple Developer account.

error.apns_incomplete: Fill in Team ID, Key ID and the key, or leave all three empty.
error.apns_bad_key: That doesn't look like a valid .p8 key.

options.silent: Silent background push (iOS may delay it)
options.off: Off (only while the app is open)
